name: Roughrider
summary: A mounted specialist whose practiced bond improves both rider and steed through charges, mobile full attacks, and heavy barding.

features.name: Steadfast Mount +1
features.summary: After one hour of practice, your mount gains +1 dodge AC and +1 morale on saves while you are mounted or adjacent.

features.name: Armored Charger
features.summary: Ignore armor check penalties on Ride; your mount keeps its speed with a medium load or medium barding.

features.name: Mounted Mettle +1
features.summary: You and your mount gain +1 on attack and damage rolls while mounted or adjacent.

features.name: Leap from the Saddle
features.summary: After your mount moves once, make a DC 20 fast dismount to take a full attack.

features.name: Relentless Steed
features.summary: Your mount keeps its speed in heavy barding or under a heavy load; reroll one Ride check or mount save per day, plus once per four levels beyond 11th.

features.name: Ride Them Down
features.summary: During one mount move, make a full attack at any points along the movement; Trample can replace attacks with overruns.

features.name: Unavoidable Onslaught
features.summary: Friendly creatures and difficult terrain no longer block your mounted charge.

features.name: Indomitable Steed
features.summary: You and your steed gain DR 5/— while you are mounted.
